Aelatanian Passes: These wide passes are the most frequent route through the central mountains.
Aiven Crossing: The town of Aiven is an important crossroads for many Azincournean roads.
Alanca: This small town specializes in fishing.
Anderu: Town of Anderu governs over many of the vast fields of Northern Heilonia.
Arcburg: A major Naragonese city, Arcburg is the former seat of the current Naragonese royal family.
Arcepte: This central Révian town watches over an important regional crossroad.
Arcessfort: A powerful fortress watching over the southern Azincournean border.
Astrae: A mighty harbor, Astrae is the historic seat of Aelatanian nobility.
Astraean Coast: Coast around the town of Astrae is a hotspot of royal leisure.
Atoney: This harbor town serves as a regional trading hub, especially with ships coming from Amennia.
Aurent: A mining town in the valleys of Duchy of Daurels.
Avantgardian Road: This road is a major trading route between Révia and Azincourne.
Beleta: This borderlands town of Révia is often regarded as the 'Capital of Bards'.
Beleton: This mighty fortress of Azincourne stands watch over its southwestern border.
Bolere: A small town on the borderlands of Révia.
Calastre Valley: This Azincournean region is oftentimes viewed by Naragonthid as an incursion into their lands.
Climb of Nioraient: This steeply rising path has been the demise of many travelers.
Daurels: A major regional capital of southern Azincourne, this historic city is a wonder to behold.
Delonve Edges: This convergence of mountain paths is a dangerous area to navigate.
Delunce: This minor town lies at the feet of the high mountains.
Eirance: Hidden in a valley, this mining town is one of the most remote places in the mountains.
Eleques: Sitting near the peak of a mountain, Eleques is a welcome respite for any weary travelers.
Emmine: Nested on a mountain path, this small town controls mountain paths to its north.
Enciantan Ravine: Carved between two mountains, this ravine is almost as dangerous as the highest peaks.
Entaron: The capital of Révia, this city and its environs are one of the richest regions of the continent.
Euleira: This Naragonese town sits on a major trading route between Azincourne and Naragonthid.
Euleira Road: A major trading route between Naragonthid and Azincourne.
Generax: The regional capital of Northern Heilonia, this city is a mighty bastion of Azincournean power.
Generax Fields: Situated to the east of Generax, these fields supply much of the city's food.
Generax Pastures: Vast, green fields supply most of Generax's meat, leather and wool.
Great South Heilonic Fields: These fields in northern Venexia are a vast collection of small fields and pastures.
Havage: This Naragonese town is a site of a major training ground.
High Mountain Paths: These paths along the mountainside are the bane of even the most experienced travelers.
Hosfan: A major Amennian town near the Azincournean border.
Hosfan Fields: Fields of wine and corn surrounding the city of Hosfan.
Lanta: This Azincournean border town is in the heart of former Heilonia.
Lantaran Forest: An important game hunting spot for Aelatanian nobility and hunters.
Lecce: This Venexian town sits on an important trading route between the neutral countries.
Leyana: This major town is watching over the road leading to northern Aelatania.
Lires: A minor town specializing in forestry.
Loira: Large lumber yards surround this quaint little town.
Nioraient: This major mountain town is standing in shadow of tall mountain spires.
Nixraec Forest: A vast woodland lying at the feet of the mountains.
North Angarfen Forest: Northern part of the largest forest in Azincourne.
North Daurels Pass: A passageway leading outwards from the city of Daurels.
Pardes: This Venexian town watches over the Great South Heilonic Fields.
Passes of Finles: The town of Finles watches over a major military route between Daurels and Arcessfort.
Plein: This Révian town specializes in processing raw ingredients into mead.
South Angarfen Forest: Southern part of the largest forest in Azincourne.
The Peaks of Ancaquarne: Thin paths lead among the numerous peaks of Ancaquarne - the tallest mountains of Azincourne.
The Tall Pass: A group of dangerous crossings leading towards Eleques.
Valley of Lossarne: This crossroads is a major strategic point in southern defenses of Azincourne.
Velene: This Aelatan town houses the Manor of Aelan, the summer palace of the royal Azincournean house.
Venira: Forests and wild rivers surround this peaceful little hamlet.
